title: The passport
summary: Pre-season tour, the airport, and a team-mate has left his passport in a taxi. The squad is boarding. Somebody has to stay behind with him, and the gaffer is looking at you. A season on, the same airport.

ends.title: Stayed behind
ends.text: You stayed at the airport with a team-mate who'd lost his passport. You got the next day's flight. He's kept your seat on every coach since.

ends.title: Boarded
ends.text: You got on the plane. Your team-mate found his passport in his other jacket, at home, the next morning.

beats.title: Gate closing

event.title: Gate closing
event.speaker: mate
setup: Pre-season tour, the airport, the gate's closing. {mate.name} has left his passport in a taxi. He's ringing the taxi firm with shaking hands. {manager.short} looks at the squad, then at you.

say: "Somebody stays with him. Next flight's tomorrow at six. Anyone?"

stay.text: Twenty hours in an airport hotel. The taxi brings the passport at midnight. You play cards with the driver. {mate.short} buys you a breakfast the size of a door.

board.text: You get on. He waves at the window like it's a ship. Somebody from the club's office stays with him.

beats.hint: Someone's lost something at the airport

beats.title: The same airport

event.title: The same airport
event.speaker: mate
setup: A season on, the same airport. {mate.short} is holding his passport up above his head at the check-in desk, for you to see.

outcomes.text: He's saved you the seat next to him. He always does now. He has his passport in a little pouch round his neck, like a child.
He laughs. He sits with someone else.
"Never again," he says. He's got two passports' worth of photocopies in his bag, just in case.
He doesn't find it funny. It was his other jacket.

beats.hint: A season on, the airport again
